en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The servant who happens to be oppressed, so he does not cease to supplicate until he (himself) becomes unjust’ (for excessively supplicating against him).
en.sarwar: 17. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘A servant (of Allah) may become oppressed and continues praying against the oppressor until he himself becomes an oppressor (for excessive praying against him).”’
